scanNotes: 2026-11-11: Partial entertainment discovery through 10 January, plus wider Indian touring/cultural searches into early March. Added four verified mdw Pop-up Adventkalender concerts: City Hall opening 30 November at 18:00; Duo Roséwa at Café Landtmann 1 December at 16:00 (approximately 40 minutes); Kostner con Spirito at Bezirksmuseum Mariahilf 6 December at 11:30; Freedom Square & Voices4u at IKEA Wien Nord 22 December at 16:00. Individual official pages confirm free entry. City Hall requires registration and says its link will follow; other three require no registration. Other finish times left null.

Rechecked today’s Diversity Ball Dance and Dialogbüro screening, plus Silent Ecologies and Party Modern. Remaining booking capacity was not checked. Rechecked Alszeilenmarkt and Prater parades. Expanded Böhmischer Prater’s Mehr anzeigen in the live organiser page and confirmed 13 December 17:00–18:30, free entry and voluntary charity donations; advanced its checked date. Wurstfabrik individual page remains inaccessible. Removed completed Il Riposo and Lesbian Space Princess records and pruned past museum and party occurrences.

Rechecked Wien Museum admission/hours and first-Sunday rule, HGM, Secession, Leopold PORR Night, Jewish Museum admission/hours, hdgö, November Belvedere release and Horten programme. Extended Wien Museum permanent collection to 10 January. Rechecked OeNB Geldmuseum’s free entry, Tue–Fri 09:00–17:00 and holiday closures; extended to 8 January, excluding 6 January. Horten December slots remain sold out and November Belvedere booking opens 13 November. Kunsthalle November page read, but combined date/location checked dates retained; December not fully rechecked. Musa admission section not exposed; retained prior check and dates.

City winter-events and Karmelitermarkt concert pages returned 500 errors after useful official indexed search results; those concert leads were not added. City free-museum directory and Fire Brigade Museum also returned 500 errors. An mdw alias returned 502; the canonical mdw.ac.at pages succeeded. District-museum directory readable, but full museumGuide source set not reverified; guide unchanged. Wider Indian-event searches and current Zeppelin overview yielded no additional verified local match. Unrechecked future records retain old checked dates; coverage remains partial.
